contentBlocks.text: This week you've learned all four essential postpositions. Today: combine them into full sentences, connecting back to your translation-practice skills!

Real sentences often use more than one postposition at once. Using last week's translation-practice skills, translate this full sentence into Punjabi, using at least two of this week's four postpositions correctly: 'I am going with my friend to school.'
You just translated a full sentence using multiple postpositions! Tomorrow we'll review everything from this week.

objectives: Combine multiple postpositions correctly in one translated sentence
Connect this week's grammar skill to last week's translation-practice skill
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's four postpositions together.
2. Model translating the full example sentence step by step.
3. Have the child complete their own translation independently.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's cumulative review.
differentiationTips: Struggling: translate the sentence in two separate chunks (with my friend / to school) before combining them into one full sentence
Ready for more: ask the child to write their own original sentence using all four postpositions from this week
This is the week's synthesis moment — combining grammar and translation skills together is the genuinely important goal here
teacherGuide.answerKey: A correct translation uses ਨਾਲ for 'with my friend' and ਨੂੰ for 'to school,' for example: ਮੈਂ ਦੋਸਤ ਨਾਲ ਸਕੂਲ ਨੂੰ ਜਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹਾਂ — check that the child's version correctly places both postpositions after their nouns.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses this course's advanced-grammar and translation-practice threads together, synthesizing this week's four postpositions before tomorrow's review.

generationData.instructions: Translate the full sentence into Punjabi.

prompts.prompt: Translate: 'I am going with my friend to school.'
